what is webhook | webhook meaning | define webhook | webhook explained simply => A webhook is a URL that a service calls automatically when something happens, like Discord posting a message when your server gets a request.
what is nat | what is network address translation | nat meaning | define nat | nat explained simply => NAT lets many devices share one public IP address by having the router track which inside device each connection belongs to.
what is subnet | subnet meaning | define subnet | subnet explained simply => A subnet is a slice of a network. The subnet mask says which part of an IP address is the network and which is the device.
what is gateway | gateway meaning | define gateway | gateway explained simply => The default gateway is usually your router, where a device sends data meant for other networks like the internet.
what is vpn | vpn meaning | define vpn | vpn explained simply => A VPN sends your internet traffic through an encrypted tunnel to another server, hiding it from the local network. It does not make you fully anonymous.
what is tls | tls meaning | define tls | tls explained simply => TLS encrypts connections like HTTPS. A certificate proves a website really owns its domain, checked by your browser.
what is certificate authority | certificate authority meaning | define certificate authority | certificate authority explained simply => A certificate authority is a trusted organization that issues the certificates that prove websites are who they claim to be.
what is sql injection | sql injection meaning | define sql injection | sql injection explained simply => SQL injection is an attack where someone types database commands into a form. Using parameterized queries instead of building SQL text stops it.
what is cross site scripting | what is xss | cross site scripting meaning | define cross site scripting | cross site scripting explained simply => Cross-site scripting is an attack that sneaks JavaScript into a web page others view. Escaping user text before showing it prevents it.
what is backup | backup meaning | define backup | backup explained simply => A backup is a spare copy of your files. The 3-2-1 rule says keep 3 copies, on 2 kinds of storage, with 1 somewhere else, like the cloud.
what is open wifi risks | what is public wifi safety | open wifi risks meaning | define open wifi risks | open wifi risks explained simply => On public WiFi others might watch unencrypted traffic, so only use HTTPS sites and avoid logging into important accounts if you can.
what is json api | what is json web api | json api meaning | define json api | json api explained simply => A JSON API is a web service that sends and receives data as JSON, which most apps and games use to talk to servers.
what is graphql | graphql meaning | define graphql | graphql explained simply => GraphQL is a way for apps to ask a server for exactly the data they need in one request, using a query language.
what is oauth | what is sign in with google | oauth meaning | define oauth | oauth explained simply => OAuth lets you log into an app using another account, like Google or Apple, without giving the app your password.
what is http headers | http headers meaning | define http headers | http headers explained simply => HTTP headers are extra information sent with requests and responses, like the content type, cookies or authorization tokens.
what is status code 404 | what is 404 error | status code 404 meaning | define status code 404 | status code 404 explained simply => A 404 error means the server could not find the page or resource at that address.
what is status code 500 | what is 500 error | status code 500 meaning | define status code 500 | status code 500 explained simply => A 500 error means something went wrong on the server itself, not with your request.
what is peer to peer | what is p2p | peer to peer explained simply => Peer-to-peer means devices connect directly to each other instead of through a central server, like some multiplayer games and file sharing.
